display.title: Eye Of The Last Room
display.description: Use the completed atlas to find a Stronghold and return with End-bound proof.

tracker.text: Bring 4 ender pearls for the last-room calculations.
tracker.complete_text: The ender pearls are packed in ash paper.

proof.text: Bring an Eye of Ender and 4 ender pearls from the stronghold route.

return.text: Return to the cartographer with the stronghold bearing.

start: The last room hides near {target_x}, {target_z}, {distance} blocks {direction}. Reach the Stronghold and bring an Eye of Ender with pearls for the atlas.
reminder: Stronghold near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring an Eye of Ender and 4 ender pearls after you stand in those halls.
turn_in: This is where the map stops pretending the world is flat. The atlas has found the door.
already_completed: The last-room bearing is already inked.
unavailable: The atlas needs its Nether meridian before it can read the last room.
inactive: The stronghold page is not open right now.
missing_target: The eye needs the Stronghold bearing behind it.
missing_proof: Bring an Eye of Ender before I close this page.
locate_failed: The Stronghold mark is too faint from this table today.
